scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them out, but never at night. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, with warm water. She'll be at pier four at first light tomorrow.

scenes.title: Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The flooded tunnel is warm and smells of candle wax, with hymn-book pages floating on the water. One page has "M. Brand" pencilled in the margin, and Teo recognises his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya guess that Maren is in the cult. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: Midnight bell at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother, who takes children from the shore, and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times and the humming is much louder than two nights ago. Pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor under the water. GM note: choir clock at three of six. The party flees.

scenes.title: Plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull tavern, Gullwick Docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide by day, with Sela rowing at first light. Bram the innkeeper feeds them and says Maren has a good heart and lost a brother to the bay. Long rest, full HP.
